name: Haldiram khatta mitha
ingredients: Refined Palmolein Oil, Rice Flakes (22%), Bengal Gram Flour (Besan) (21%), Refined Sugar, Split Pulse Bengal Gram (Chana Dal) (7%), Groundnuts (Peanuts) (5%). Sago (4%), Red Lentils (Masur Whole) (2.5%), Green peas, Iodised Salt, Black Salt, Turmeric, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Red Chilli, Ajwain, Raising Agent (INS 500 ii) & Asafoetida. Allergen: Contains Peanuts May Contains Tree nuts, Wheat, Milk, Soy, Mustard Seed & Sesame Seed
